title: US monthly equity expiration (May 2027)
source: EST: Cboe's own machine-readable settlement endpoint plus the 30-day VIX-futures rule, both re-verified direct 2026-09-06. www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200 after one 301, 1,731 bytes) returns the row `VX,VX/J7,2027-04-21,21.0267`, and the same file fetched for dt=2026-09-03 (HTTP 200, 1,733 bytes) returns `VX,VX/J7,2027-04-21,21.15` -- the same expiration date against two different daily settlement prices, so the date is the contract's and not one day's artifact. VIX futures AM-settle exactly 30 calendar days before the SPX expiration they reference; 2027-04-21 + 30 days = 2027-05-21, which is independently the third Friday of May 2027 by weekday arithmetic (May 2027 Fridays: 7, 14, 21, 28). THE RULE IS SELF-VALIDATING AGAINST THIS REPO'S OWN CALENDAR: applied to the other four 2027 VX rows on the same file it reproduces every opex entry already tracked and invents none -- VX/F7 2027-01-20 -> opex-2027-02-19, VX/G7 2027-02-17 -> opex-2027-03-19, VX/H7 2027-03-17 -> opex-2027-04-16, VX/K7 2027-05-18 -> opex-2027-06-17 (the Juneteenth-displaced Thursday, itself corroborated on the same file by the variance row `VA,VA/M7,2027-06-17,319.25`). 2027-05-21 is the single date the rule produces that this calendar does not already carry. This is the same primary surface and the same arithmetic by which opex-2027-06-17 was filed on 2026-09-05. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED during the consumer-confidence-2027-05-25 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). This is a GAP FILL, not a discovery: the repo tracks opex-2027-02-19, opex-2027-03-19, opex-2027-04-16 and opex-2027-06-17, and May 2027 is the one month in that run with no entry -- the sweep found it because 2027-05-21 sits 4 days before this proposer's print and therefore inside the deterministic screen's +/-5-day adjacency window, where an absent entry is invisible by construction. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep and because theocc.com and the cdn.cboe.com expiration-calendar PDF both 403 from this runner; `OCC:` is the prefix this class promotes under. IMPACT LOW, and the proposer's own research is the evidence: no house playbook is opex- or calendar-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped 2026-09-06 for macro|sentiment|consumer confidence|conference board, one hit at trade-playbooks.md:115 and it is a portfolio-weighting input, not a playbook). WHAT IT IS ADJACENT TO: this is an ordinary monthly expiration, NOT a quarterly triple witching -- the 2027 quarterlies are 03-19, 06-17, 09-17 and 12-17 -- so the closing-auction rebalance signature the juneteenth-market-closure-2027-06-18 lane measured on witching days (mean relative volume 2.25 across eight large caps against 1.01-1.09 on ordinary sessions of the same week) should NOT be assumed here and was not tested by this lane. It sits 3 sessions before consumer-confidence-2027-05-25, 5 before sifma-bond-early-close-2027-05-28, 6 before fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29 and 7 before memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31, and 3 days after vix-expiration-2027-05-18 (the VX/K7 settlement on the same Cboe file, already tracked as confirmed). Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry.
